scope: Completed same-version V23 live pair and verified V24 startup; trajectory-sensitive diagnosis, not isolated prefetch speedup or completed performance objective.

paired_completed_jct.semantics: The same instances completed in both arms; negative deltas favor left. Unpaired completions and shared outcome differences remain explicit. Eligibility flags are reported without silently changing this outcome-based cohort. Request, tool and delegation counts describe realized demand; matching tasks does not match execution traces or establish causal speedup.

busy_window_600_2400.scope: observed live busy windows, not a completed pair or causal speedup

gpu_restore_dependency_wait.semantics: Sampled CUDA-stream native layer-dependency waits including event overhead; not all H2D, not request queue delay or an oracle JCT bound.

measurement_notes: Live generation can produce different request traces in each policy.
No incomplete-run JCT or completed-only workflow comparison is included.
Decode token deltas belong to their completed worker batch's window.
LLM output lengths separately belong to the request completion window.
Worker intervals are scheduler/worker wall intervals, not CUDA kernel durations.
Input/cache token counts belong to submission, not the actual GPU-service window.
Transfer payloads and measured batch durations belong to the physical submission window.
Only completed transfer receipts are included; live pending batches are not credited.
Physical batch durations are counted once, even when payload sources share a batch.
JOIN/tool source bytes require separate event-boundary and first-reuse checks to prove anticipation.
Restore dependency waits are sampled CUDA layer waits, not per-request queue wait or all-batch totals.
GPU utilization is the mean of monitor samples within each window.
A trailing unfinished JSONL record is excluded from this read.

interpretation: Full-run means and completion throughput are affected by unequal completions, realized demand and late tools; they do not prove the performance objective.
Paired JCT uses only the same instances completed in both arms. Preserve two predictive incomplete outcomes and unpaired native completions.
The 600-2400 second windows precede the recorded disk maintenance bounds for both arms. Their difference still does not isolate policy causality.
Worker intervals and cumulative transfer-stream times are not kernel duration or removable critical-path JCT.
V24 runs predictive first, then cold same-version native. Startup and lowered tool-offload metadata do not establish throughput gains.
